verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents an official MCP server (mcp-clickhouse) that connects AI assistants to ClickHouse, and its CLI can execute queries, so agents have first-party tooling for database work. Nothing in the evidence shows how those tools are scoped, or that they separate read-only from destructive operations. missing for 10: documented separation of read-only and destructive tools, scoped permissions or a read-only mode for agent access, documentation of schema-operation tools, independent or hands-on corroboration of safe delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run SQL and schema operations through scoped tools that distinguish read-only from destructive actions, so I can safely delegate database work

citations.quote: Connect ClickHouse to your AI assistants.
